title: Community Support for Individuals and Society to Understand Global Conflicts
what_it_is: Community Support for Individuals and Society to Understand Global Conflicts

sections.label: Harmony Circles and Asatizah Solace Care
sections.summary: Harmony Circles run interfaith initiatives and fundraising, and asatizah offer counselling, including PERGAS's Asatizah Solace Care.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Our Racial and Religious Harmony Circles organise inter-ethnic and interfaith initiatives to build trust across communities, such as the Peace and Harmony Dialogue in October 2024 that discussed the Gaza situation; and more recently, a youth seminar in January 2026 that sought to empower youths to act against extremism in the digital age.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In 2024, our Harmony Circles organised the Harmony-in-Action fundraising campaign supporting RLAF's Gaza efforts, raising half a million dollars.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: For those in our Muslim community who need a listening ear or someone to discuss these issues with, they can approach our asatizah, who are trained to provide counselling and appropriate guidance.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: One example is Asatizah Solace Care, a service initiated by the Singapore Islamic Scholars and Religious Teachers Association (PERGAS), which provides a free, safe and confidential platform for individuals and families seeking emotional and spiritual support to talk about any concerns.

sections.label: Asatizah Solace Care open to all
sections.summary: Asatizah Solace Care is open to all.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Yes, indeed, the Asatizah Solace Care is open to all.

sections.label: Asatizah training and national interest
sections.summary: Asatizah receive continuing education and training under the Asatizah Recognition Scheme to engage and support the community.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We may have different positions and opinions, but when we discuss issues of national interest, many in our community agree that we should put our national interest first.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, when we look at the support provided – for example, to our asatizah – we provide them with training through continuing education and training, which is CET.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Under the Asatizah Recognition Scheme, they undergo programmes to improve and prepare themselves in engaging our community.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: This includes how they can provide emotional and spiritual support to the community, including issues related to the current conflict.
